punchline: The hand was allowed; the cup that freed the hand was banned.
thirty_sec: The Hush-A-Phone was a privacy cup for the mouthpiece. AT&T banned it and the FCC agreed in 1951, but on 8 November 1956 an appeals court said it made no sense to allow a cupped hand and forbid the device.
question: Which improvement presented to you as forbidden has an allowed near twin?
key_contrast: The test was real harm, not whether the device came from the company.
